title: Suburbicarian
summary: SUBURBICA'RIAN SUBURB'ICARY, adjective [Low Latin suburbicarius.] Being in the suburbs; an epithet applied to the provinces of Italy which composed the ancient diocese of Rome.

inlines.v: SUBURBICA'RIAN SUBURB'ICARY, adjective [Low Latin suburbicarius.] Being in the suburbs; an epithet applied to the provinces of Italy which composed the ancient diocese of Rome.
